fuel_consumption.source_quote: Fuel gallons consumed (thousands): 169,010 for FY2015 per item7 statistical table.

instrument_type_details.notes: Instruments: Fixed Forward Price contracts (FFPs), forward swaps, call options for crude oil, collar contracts for heating oil. At Dec 31, 2015: 35% of next 12 months' fuel hedged at ~$1.59/gal (in excess of market prices). All existing contracts expected to settle by end of Q3 2016. Net fair value = -$27.6M (liability), offset by $9.7M margin call deposits, net overall liability = $17.9M. At Dec 31, 2014: -$27.1M gross liability, -$12.7M net. 10% price increase sensitivity: +$14.7M fuel expense. Virgin America acquired by Alaska Airlines (merger announced April 2016; completed December 2016).
